answer: Proposal: admit only keys certified inside a TEE. The ledger stores each enclave's remote-attestation quote, checked against the chipmaker's root certificate, and admits one scoring identity per attested key per epoch; the enclave's measured kernel signs actions, so keys exported elsewhere fail re-attestation. Resin passed as ivory fails assay; unattested clones fail this check. Weight means buying real devices — linear cost, deterring only while amortized price plus exploit risk tops capped epoch reward. Each scoring voyage needs a fresh quote; vendor capture and side-channels remain open.
